text:
Evan: FYI customer wants BYOK for Private with emergency operator import only. Key constraints: zero-Redwood-plaintext guarantee, two-person approval, per-import region residency, WORM audit, and a forensic artifact for compliance. Thoughts on RBAC + logging? cc @Nadia @Rohit

Nadia: RBAC call: create scoped role 'byok-operator' limited to /kms/import and /kms/import-status. Require two independent approvers and hardware-backed MFA. Tokens should be ephemeral (TTL < 5m) and auto-revoke after import window.

Rohit: Pipeline: accept only wrapped key material + customer PoP. Perform attestation: operator workstation + HSM identity + fw version check. Block imports if hsm_fw < 5.2.2 or attestation fails. Never store unwrapped key outside the HSM; persist only wrapped blob + import envelope.

Claire: Audit: emit an immutable import record per event that contains trace_id, operator_ids, approval_ids, approver_methods, hsm_fw_version, attestation_sha256, tenant_region, and import_result. Prefer HSM-signed log entry or service-signed with HSM key. Route logs to tenant-region WORM bucket by default.

audit-bot: audit-bot: scanning schema -> missing fields: approval_ids, attestation_sha256, tenant_region, operator_role. Raised SEC-3301 to extend audit schema and backfill 120d.

ops-oncall: IR notes: on anomalous import pattern -> 1) revoke all active byok-operator tokens, 2) freeze import API for tenant, 3) snapshot HSM audit channel and export signed import events, 4) notify security/legal and customer within 1 hour, 5) initiate forensics playbook. Include tabletop for this scenario.

Evan: Risk: CVE-2024-XYZ impacts some HSM images. Action: block imports from affected fw, notify customers with affected keys, and schedule patch/rewrap plan.

Nadia: Action items: Ill draft RBAC + JIT UI mock. Rohit: document attestation checks + sample canonical event. Claire: draft retention/residency options and contract wording (no-unwrap clause). Ops-oncall: update runbook and schedule drill.

Evan: Thanks team. Will consolidate into BYOK-import RFC and circulate.
